home.passport_label: About the author and the site

principles.title: Facts matter more than impressions
principles.text: I prefer what can be verified to what sounds good. If I don't know something or can't confirm it, I say so.

principles.title: Openness has limits
principles.text: I don't hide mistakes and don't pass guesses off as facts. I give sources, dates and corrections. At the same time, not everything from private life has to be public.

principles.title: For contact — email
principles.text: If you want to reach me, write a letter. There are no comments, chats or other ways to communicate on this site.

principles.title: No publication schedule
principles.text: I don't commit to updating the site regularly. I publish when I have something to add. Breaks can be long.
